cells.gaps: The Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2025 was last heard of at a November 2021 workshop (CAF-004); no row says it was adopted or published, and its 2020-2025 period has ended (CAF-005). No successor national strategy is on record: the government-class strategies validated in August 2026 and the PND 2024-2028 are noted classes. CAF-030 (June 2023) names the ACDD's mission as implementing a national strategy for the digital ecosystem, but falls before the 36-month window and sets no standing.
cells.note: Lowered on review from 2: the only rung-2 row is a 2021 workshop on a plan for 2020-2025 that was never adopted and has ended, with nothing on it since, so it no longer shows a strategy in preparation. An ended strategy with no successor is unplaced and lapsed, as Tunisia's is.
